wallet.comment: 24-word BIP39 seed of the deploy wallet. MUST hold at least 500 ADA (≈400 for ref scripts + ~50 for ceremony fees + headroom) and the initial test USDCx balance (≈15 USDCx for vault seed).

depositToken.comment: Preprod test USDCx. 'policy' is 28-byte hex. 'name' is hex of asset name (e.g. 0x5465737455534443 = ASCII "TestUSDC"). Replace both with the actual Preprod test token you intend to use. Most teams mint their own test asset for Preprod.

governance.comment: 3-of-3 unanimity at launch (matches whitepaper §5.5 rationale). Per V1 internal audit, threshold == n is allowed. governanceNftAssetName = hex of "OptiVaultsGV" (12 bytes). registryAuthAssetName = hex of "RegistryAuth" (12 bytes). Both are arbitrary-length asset names up to 32 bytes.

vaultInitialParams.comment: 15 ADA operational buffer for DEX orders + min-UTXO. Launch performance_fee_bps=450 (4.5% hard cap), keeper_fee_bps=4000 (40% — at validator hard cap to support open-source third-party keeper viability), gov_fee_bps=0 (Phase 1, disabled). Treasury share = 60% derived.

treasuryInitialParams.comment: 40/25/25/10 launch split. Audit bumped to 40% (vs older 30%) so audit reserve accumulation rate stays at 24% of total fee under the new 40% keeper share (60% treasury × 40% audit = 24%, matches the prior 80% × 30% = 24%). min_audit_reserve=0 at launch (non-binding); future UpdateParams can raise but never lower. Monthly caps all 500 USDCx for simplicity — governance-adjustable via UpdateTreasuryParams.

keeperAuthInitialParams.comment: Phase 1 launch: GovernanceOnly + single keeper PKH = founder keeper. bond_amount_required (100 ADA) + failover mechanics are inert at launch; relevant only when governance later flips RegistrationMode to Mixed/PermissionlessWithBond (post $5-10M TVL).

registryInitialParams.comment: Empty whitelists at launch — no DeployToProtocol calls work until governance adds protocol_hashes via UpdateRegistry. Liqwid market entries added post-launch per `docs/integration-playbook.md`. keeper_pkh used for KeeperToggleMarket (emergency Liqwid market pause); immutable after deploy per internal verification.

ceremonyOptions.comment: Ref-script min-ADA multiplier — 10% headroom over Cardano ledger minimum to avoid min-ADA rejection in borderline cases. Mint deadline offset is unused for V1 (mints are cryptographic UTXO-ref one-shots, not native-script deadlines). awaitConfirmSeconds = how long to wait for Blockfrost indexer to see each TX before the next step.
